label: GO step, choosing a2 after an unrewarded trial (late in episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass) and almost only when the agent is about to choose a2 (model_act==2 / strongly negative policy logit; 99.7% of mass), and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward 0 holds 95% of mass; never when in_rew==1; also fires on the rare penalty/D1-error trials). Rate climbs steeply with episode trial (near zero before trial ~30, peaks trials 80-99) and with low value-head output (never active at value >= 8.1). Largest activations come late in runs of consecutive unrewarded a2 choices (activation ramps across successive r0 a2 trials in top windows). Does not fire at D1 or D2, on a1 choices, or after rewarded trials. Simpler predicate GO & model_act==2 & prev_reward!=1 gives dev F1 0.57 / mass recall 0.95; adding ep_trial>=40 raises F1 to 0.70 (mass 0.92), so that one was recorded. Uses only observed inputs plus the agent own upcoming choice; no future variables. Precision remains incomplete: many unrewarded a2 GO steps late in episodes stay silent.
